name: app-pearl-cards-app-in-hand-with-dark-spending-widget-on-lifestyle-photo
title: Lifestyle photo with a dark spend widget beside a hand holding a pearl card-management app
whatItIs: A split image: at left a smiling man on a sofa with a phone and a frosted black card 'Monthly Spending Overview' with $4.04k and a ring showing 40,135 transactions; at right a hand holds a pale phone with a serif 'Manage Your Cards' and a fanned pearl card stack.
whatItMeans: Human and premium; a dark widget over life and a pale UI in hand show two moods of one brand.
techniques: Overlay a dark glass widget on a lifestyle photo.
Show a ring chart with a gradient stroke.
Fan pearl cards in the UI.
Split dark and light in one image.

vocabulary.definition: A black translucent card overlaid on a photo.
A ring chart with a big central number.
A dark and a light visual side by side.
